RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the March 4, 2008/Phalguna 14, 1929 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
26
Setting up of international airports in
Madhya Pradesh
†*81. SHRIMATI MAY A SINGH: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of airports operating in
Madhya Pradesh at present alongwith the
locations thereof;
(b) whether any proposal is under
consideration of Government for
construction of new airports of
international standard in order to extend
facility for movement of the people of
Madhya Pradesh as also to promote
tourism; and
(c) if so, by when the construction work
of these airports would be started?
Strength of employees in PSUs
*82. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI PRASANTA CHATTERJEE:
Will the Minister of HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of permanent employees
working in PSUs under the administrative
control of his Ministry as on 31 March,
2007 (unit-wise break up); and
(b) the number of contract/casual/
contingency workers working in these units
as on 31 March, 2007?
Losses incurred by Air India
*83. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR :
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that according to
the original financial documents presented
to the Board, Air India had recorded its
biggest ever net loss of Rs. 541.3 crore for
the financial year 2006-07;
(b) whether it is also a fact that airline's
poor on time record and disregard for
passenger comfort has resulted in what a
Board member described as 'a loss of
customer confidence'; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor and the
action proposed to address the issue?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

27
Inflation rate in India
†*84. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that during the
period from September, 2007 to January,
2008, the inflation rate in India has remained
high in comparison to the other leading
economies of the world;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what has been the average inflation
rate during the above said period in America,
England, European countries, Japan and
China; and
(d) the extent to which this rate is more
or less, in comparison to the average
inflation rate of India?
Fall in the Sensex
*85. SHRI P.R. RAJAN:
SHRIMATI  SUSHMA  SWARAJ:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has assessed
the reasons for the recent fall in the Sensex;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of loss incurred by
investors in the recent crash of Sensex; and
(d) the amount of money Government
had to pump in for saving the Sensex from
further going down?
Restoration work of monuments in
Rajasthan and Sikkim
*86. SHRI O.T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) what is Government's policy for
undertaking restoration/maintenance work
of temples, churches, mosques and other
monuments, particularly in the States of
Rajasthan and Sikkim;
(b) the details of work of each of these
temples, churches, mosques and other
monuments in the above States;
(c) the details of funds sanctioned and
expenditure incurred; and
(d) the details of projects in pipeline?
New licensing policy for oil and gas
exploration
†*87. SHRI SANJAY RAUT:
SHRI DATTA MEGHE:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the production of oil and
gas in the oil and gas reserves found in
Krishna Godavari basin, Tapti Gas area and
Bikaner region of Rajasthan will be started
in the year 2008;
(b) if so, the total quantum of oil and
gas to be made available from these areas;
(c) whether Government has prepared
any new licensing policy for the exploration
of oil and gas; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

28
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Amendments to the Income Tax Act,
1961
*88. SHRI M.V . MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
bring out the necessary amendments to
Section 10(17) of the Income Tax Act, 1961
providing exemption of tax on all
allowances to Members of Legislative
Assembly of Andhra Pradesh at par with
the Members of Parliament;
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any respresentation in this
respect has been received from the State
Government of Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) if so, what action has been taken
thereon by the Central Government?
Action against flying clubs/institutes
*89. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAW A T:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the steps Government is taking to
ensure that different flying clubs and flying
institutes are following strictly the norms
required for training the pilots and giving
them the licenses; and
(b) the institutes found to be issuing
false reports and false licenses and what
action Government has taken against them?
Negligence in landing of aircrafts
†*90. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYA VRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as a result of
the negligence in the operation of planes
from international airports, two dozen
planes were landed in emergency situation
in the year 2007;
(b) whether the landing of two planes
was made on 22 April, 2007 at Indira
Gandhi International Airport at an interval
of 15 minutes and these two planes
narrowly escaped collision on the runway;
(c) whether guidelines have been issued
to stop such types of incidents; and
(d) how many such cases have been
investigated?
Forgery by Carver Aviation Academy
*91. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Director
General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) which
probed the functioning of Carver Aviation
Academy in Baramati, Maharashtra found
forgery in the manner in which flight test
certificates were being issued to aspiring
pilots;
(b) if so, the details of its findings;
(c) whether it is also a fact that DGCA
decided to suspend the operation of said
Academy and if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government reversed the
order of the DGCA despite police warning

29
that the scandal has grave security and
criminal implications; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?
Grounding of overweight air hostesses
*92. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIA TION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
overweight air hostesses of State-run carrier
of India have been grounded; and
(b) if so, the number of such air
hostesses grounded and what will be their
future?
Criteria for setting up new airports in
the country
*93. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
plans to develop 500 new airports in the
country; and
(b) if so, the details as to number of
airports per State and also what is the
criteria for selection of different airports
for development?
Subsidies to BPL families
†*94. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELW AL: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that benefits of
different kinds of subsidy being extended
to Below Poverty Line families/consumers
in the country is not reaching them;
(b) if so, whether Government proposes
to reconsider different kinds of subsidy
being provided by Government; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Mud clay pack treatment on Taj
Mahal
*95. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has started the
mud clay pack treatment on the Taj Mahal,
which has become due now;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the cost involved and scheduled date of
completion of work;
(c) whether Government has made any
feasibility study of some other countries
to know the effectiveness of mud clay pack
on the white marble;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Greenfield airports in Rajasthan and
Andhra Pradesh
*96. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) what are the Greenfield airports
being planned to be developed in different
parts of the country; and
(b) whether there is any Greenfield
airport proposed to be developed in the
States of Rajasthan and Andhra Pradesh?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

30
Rise in economic offences
*97. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
economic offences are on the rise in the
country, particularly, credit card frauds;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether gullible people are being
targeted through lucrative marketing and
pre-launch schemes by various banks or
financial institutions; and
(d) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take to check such rising trend
of economic offences in the country?
Life and mediclaim insurance policies
*98. SHRI HARISH RAW A T: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plans to ensure
that different insurance companies bring
out some policies of life insurance and
medical insurance at much cheaper rate from
time to time;
(b) whether Government plans to cover
every citizen of the country under medical
insurance in some form or the other;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, what is the percentage of
people expected to be under mediclaim in
the country?
N
EW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 27th February, 2008 Secretary-General.
Phalguna 8, 1929 (Saka)
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Insider trading in stock markets
*99. SHRI D. RAJA: Will the Minister
of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that massive
insider trading happens in the Indian Stock
Markets;
(b) if so, to what extent the Securities
and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has
been able to detect such insider trading in
the last two years;
(c) whether small investors have become
victims of crony capitalism and insider
trading in the Indian economy; and
(d) the steps likely to be taken to
apprehend such culprits and protect the
small investors in the near future?
Utilisation of surface and ground
water for irrigation
†*100. SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that surface water
and ground water is utilized for the
irrigation of agriculture land of the country:
(b) if so, the percentage of agriculture
land which is being irrigated through surface
and ground water; and
(c) how much volume of water capacity
has been established under water harvesting
system in order to maintain the level of
ground water?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Civil Aviation : 81, 83, 89, 90, 91, 92, 93, 96,
Corporate Affairs :—
Culture : 86, 95,
Finance : 84, 85, 88, 94, 97, 98, 99,
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises : 82,
Petroleum and Natural Gas : 87,
Tourism :—
Water Resources : 100.
31
MGIPMRND—434RS—23.02.2008.
